title: unregister: a binding_changed conflict code for a changed removal set (WCLI-137 opus L3, needs an opum-doc ruling)
description:
Opus L3 on ward-cli#258 (WCLI-137). When unregister's in-transaction check finds that the set it showed the developer changed (a binding or approval appeared or vanished, or the project changed), it refuses with project_not_registered. That code's message ("This checkout is not registered with Ward...") and hint ("Run `ward init`...") are false there: the checkout is still registered and ward init answers already-registered. It fails closed (nothing is removed). A new error code needs an opum-doc ruling, as in DEC-255 (a6) and (a7).

A/B DRAFT FOR OPUM-DOC (recommend A).
Question: how should unregister report that the records it was about to remove changed after the developer answered?
A (recommended): add a catalog code binding_changed, type conflict, in the shape of secret_changed and profile_changed. Message: "This checkout's registration changed while the command was running, so Ward removed nothing." Hint: "Run `ward unregister` again to see what is registered now." unregister raises it when the removal set differs between the question and the write, and keeps project_not_registered only for the case where no binding is present. Cost: one new catalog code and its manifest and docs entries. Benefit: the message tells the truth and the hint is actionable.
B: add no code. Narrow project_not_registered to the case where no binding is present, and reuse an existing conflict code for a changed set. The nearest, binding_conflict, says the manifest and the binding name different projects, so its message would still be wrong in this race. Cost: no catalog change, but a still-misleading message.
Recommendation: A, because the refusal is a distinct, retryable state and every comparable race in the catalog already has its own conflict code.

acceptanceCriteria.text: unregister raises a distinct conflict code, not project_not_registered, when the removal set changed between the question and the write, and nothing is removed
project_not_registered is raised only when no binding is present
The new code is in the error catalog and manifest with a message and hint that match the situation, and a test fails if the changed-set refusal reverts to project_not_registered

implementationNotes: DEC-255 (a9), opum-doc, 2026-11-03T15:38Z, merged in opum-ai/opum-doc#1607, relayed by the leader: RULED A. Add catalog code binding_changed, type conflict, in the shape of secret_changed and profile_changed. Message: "This checkout's registration changed while the command was running, so Ward removed nothing." Hint: "Run `ward unregister` again to see what is registered now." unregister raises it when the removal set differs between the question and the write; project_not_registered is kept only for the case where no binding is present. The manifest and docs gain the entry. B (reuse binding_conflict) is rejected. Additive catalog change, a contract since 0.1.1 (a6); the race check is unreleased, so no released behaviour changes code. Do not start until the leader sends the dispatch after WCLI-138.
